rationale: The Latin anchors puer, juvenis, and adolescens all point to a young male person (boy/youth) with no romantic connotation, and the Biblical quotations (Abraham taking two young men, giving a boy to drink) confirm a general sense of a young male attendant or youth. This matches young_buck.n.01 ("a teenager or a young adult male") far better than boyfriend.n.01, which implies a romantic relationship entirely absent from the source.
